events.verdict: Randle (LAL) and Embiid (PHI) briefly engage and then disengage in the post.
Randle (LAL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Embiid (PHI).
Nance Jr. (LAL) sets the screen on Simmons (PHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Simmons (PHI) legally contests Ingram's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
After communicating with the Replay Center, Simmons (PHI) is assessed a common foul.
Simmons (PHI) makes contact to Caldwell-Pope's (LAL) arm and shoulder that affects his driving shot attempt.
Nance Jr. (LAL) makes body to body contact with Holmes (PHI) that affects his SQBR.
Holmes (PHI) maintains legal guarding position on Randle's (LAL) drive to the basket.
Randle (LAL) and Embiid (PHI) briefly engage and then disengage in the post.
Randle (LAL) makes contact to Embiid's (PHI) body that affects his shot attempt.
Nance Jr. (LAL) makes marginal contact with Simmons (PHI) that does not affect his ability to secure the rebound.
Randle (LAL) maintains legal guarding position on Embiid's (PHI) driving shot attempt and Embiid loses control of the ball.
Ball (LAL) does not step out of bounds.

Ingram (LAL) makes incidental contact to Holmes' (PHI) arm after the shot has been released. The contact does not affect Holmes' jump shot attempt.
